title: NVIDIA’s OpenShell Architecture: How Enterprises Can Finally Supervise Autonomous AI Agents
description:
NVIDIA just launched a new blueprint for keeping AI agents under control. We’re breaking down what this means for your company’s security and whether it actually solves the problem of autonomous agents running wild.

What we covered:
• NVIDIA launches OpenShell, a reference architecture for safe AI agents
• Google Cloud Introduces Agent Compute Engine and Governance Framework
• Meta Faces Investor Skepticism as AI Spending Escalates Following Q3 Results

Three distinct AI stories, with lively debate, useful discoveries and practical takeaways.

What to watch tomorrow: not which AI headline was loudest, but which one quietly changed the rules.

Alex, Jamie and Rufus tell you what changed in AI, who wins, and what you do next.
